The script sets `DROP_HEAD = 6`, so it removes head 6 (columns/rows `384..447` within each 768-wide segment) instead of head 5 (`320..383`), violating "Required result" clauses 1–3, which specify keeping exactly `0..319`, `384..767` (and the corresponding q/k/v segment ranges). The slicing machinery is otherwise correct — 3 fused segments on axis 1 for `c_attn.weight`, axis 0 for the bias, single segment on axis 0 for `c_proj.weight` — and the tensor count and shapes come out right, which is why the required checks all pass and the error is silent. Since grading is bit-exact against the reference, every one of the 36 edited tensors will mismatch. Fixing it requires only changing `DROP_HEAD` to `5`.
